findings.description: The KMS key does not define a key policy, meaning it relies on the default policy that grants full access to the account root user via IAM, which can be overly permissive depending on IAM configuration. Additionally, there is no enable_key_rotation attribute set, so automatic annual key rotation is disabled, weakening cryptographic hygiene for a key protecting audit trail data.
